```{=html}
<style>
/* ==========================================================
   PUBLICATION LIST
   ========================================================== */

/* Match the original page's title offset without collapsing margins. */
.publications-page {
  padding-top: 2rem;
}

/* Collapsible navigation that stays below the website header */
:root {
  --publications-header-offset: 80px;
  --publications-jump-height: 2.6rem;
  --publications-anchor-offset: calc(80px + 3.6rem);
}

/* Let ordinary section links jump immediately on this page. */
html.publications-navigation-ready {
  scroll-behavior: auto !important;
}

.publications-jump {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--publications-header-offset);
  z-index: 50;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  padding: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #1B153E;
  border: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.publications-jump > summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  width: fit-content;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-height: 2.6rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0;
  margin: 0;
  color: #1B153E;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.4;
  list-style: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.publications-jump > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.publications-jump > summary::marker {
  content: "";
}

.publications-jump > summary:hover {
  color: #DE2221;
}

.publications-jump > summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #DE2221;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.publications-jump-icon {
  flex: 0 0 1rem;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease;
}

.publications-jump[open] .publications-jump-icon {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.publications-jump-panel {
  position: absolute;
  top: 100%;
  left: 0;
  width: min(24rem, 100%);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-height: calc(100vh - var(--publications-header-offset) - var(--publications-jump-height) - 1rem);
  max-height: calc(100dvh - var(--publications-header-offset) - var(--publications-jump-height) - 1rem);
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(27, 21, 62, 0.14);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(27, 21, 62, 0.08);
}

.publications-jump-panel ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.publications-jump-panel ul ul {
  padding-left: 1rem;
}

.publications-jump-panel a {
  display: block;
  min-height: 2.6rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem;
  border-left: 2px solid transparent;
  color: #1B153E;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.4;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

.publications-jump-panel a:hover,
.publications-jump-panel a:focus-visible {
  color: #DE2221;
  text-decoration: underline !important;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
}

.publications-jump-panel a:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #DE2221;
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

.publications-jump-panel a[aria-current="location"] {
  border-left-color: #DE2221;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Leave room for both the site header and the sticky jump control */
h2.publications-section-title,
h3.publications-category-title,
#research-platforms {
  scroll-margin-top: var(--publications-anchor-offset);
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  :root {
    --publications-header-offset: 100px;
    --publications-anchor-offset: calc(100px + 3.6rem);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .publications-jump-icon {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* HTML headings without Quarto's heading borders */
h1.publications-page-title,
h2.publications-section-title,
h3.publications-category-title {
  border: none;
  padding-bottom: 0;
}

h1.publications-page-title {
  margin: 0 0 2rem;
}

h2.publications-section-title {
  margin: 3rem 0 1.25rem;
}

/* Extra separation before the non-peer-reviewed section */
h2#non-peer-reviewed-publications {
  padding-top: 2rem;
}

h1.publications-page-title + h2.publications-section-title,
.publications-jump + h2.publications-section-title {
  margin-top: 0;
}

/* Space between the non-peer-reviewed publication categories */
h3.publications-category-title {
  margin: 2.5rem 0 1rem;
}

h2.publications-section-title + h3.publications-category-title {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

/* Full rows with red dividing lines */
.publication-list .publication-link,
.publication-list .publication-static {
  display: block;
  padding: 2rem 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #DE2221;
  color: #1B153E;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

.publication-list .publication-item:last-child .publication-link,
.publication-list .publication-item:last-child .publication-static {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #DE2221;
}

/* Title and external-link icon */
.publication-list .publication-title-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

/* Title matches the website's regular text size */
.publication-list .publication-heading {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  color: #1B153E;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.publication-list .publication-title {
  color: inherit;
  font-size: inherit;
  font-weight: inherit;
  line-height: inherit;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
}

.publication-list .publication-icon {
  flex: 0 0 1rem;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  color: #1B153E;
}

/* Prevent the enclosing link from underlining the entire row */
.publication-list .publication-link:hover,
.publication-list .publication-link:focus,
.publication-list .publication-link:focus-visible {
  color: #1B153E;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

/* Hover anywhere in a linked row to colour its title and icon red */
.publication-list .publication-link:hover .publication-heading,
.publication-list .publication-link:focus-visible .publication-heading,
.publication-list .publication-link:hover .publication-icon,
.publication-list .publication-link:focus-visible .publication-icon {
  color: #DE2221;
}

/* Underline only the title */
.publication-list .publication-link:hover .publication-title,
.publication-list .publication-link:focus-visible .publication-title {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
}

/* Visible keyboard focus */
.publication-list .publication-link:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #DE2221;
  outline-offset: 5px;
}

/* Smaller supporting text */
.publication-list .publication-authors,
.publication-list .publication-details,
.publication-list .publication-id,
.publication-list .publication-note {
  color: #1B153E;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.publication-list .publication-authors {
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
}

.publication-list .publication-details,
.publication-list .publication-id {
  margin: 0;
}

.publication-list .publication-note {
  margin: 0.6rem 0 0;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* Semibold author name and journal */
.publication-list .publication-author-highlight,
.publication-list .publication-journal {
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Slightly larger red separator dot */
.publication-list .publication-separator {
  padding: 0 0.35rem;
  color: #DE2221;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

/* Mobile: retain the same font sizes */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  h3.publications-category-title {
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }

  .publication-list .publication-link,
  .publication-list .publication-static {
    padding: 1.5rem 0;
  }

  .publication-list .publication-title-row {
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
}
</style>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  function initPublicationNavigation() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('publications-jump');
    if (!menu) return;

    const summary = menu.querySelector('summary');
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.add('publications-navigation-ready');
    const headers = [...document.querySelectorAll(
      '#quarto-header, #quarto-header .navbar, body > header.navbar'
    )];
    const sections = [...menu.querySelectorAll('nav a[href^="#"]')]
      .map(link => ({ link, target: document.getElementById(link.hash.slice(1)) }))
      .filter(section => section.target);

    sections.forEach(({ target }) => target.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'));

    let anchorOffset = 0;
    let lastHeaderHeight = -1;
    let lastMenuHeight = -1;
    let pendingFrame = null;

    function updateOffsets() {
      const headerHeight = Math.ceil(Math.max(0, ...headers.map(header => {
        const rect = header.getBoundingClientRect();
        return rect.height > 0 ? rect.bottom : 0;
      })));
      const menuHeight = Math.ceil(menu.getBoundingClientRect().height);
      anchorOffset = headerHeight + menuHeight + 16;

      if (headerHeight !== lastHeaderHeight || menuHeight !== lastMenuHeight) {
        root.style.setProperty('--publications-header-offset', `${headerHeight}px`);
        root.style.setProperty('--publications-jump-height', `${menuHeight}px`);
        root.style.setProperty('--publications-anchor-offset', `${anchorOffset}px`);
        lastHeaderHeight = headerHeight;
        lastMenuHeight = menuHeight;
      }
    }

    function updateCurrentSection() {
      let current = sections[0];
      for (const section of sections) {
        if (section.target.getBoundingClientRect().top <= anchorOffset + 24) {
          current = section;
        }
      }
      sections.forEach(section => {
        if (section === current) {
          section.link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'location');
        } else {
          section.link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
        }
      });
    }

    function queueUpdate() {
      if (pendingFrame !== null) return;
      pendingFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        pendingFrame = null;
        updateOffsets();
        updateCurrentSection();
      });
    }

    sections.forEach(({ link }) => {
      link.addEventListener('click', event => {
        if (event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
        updateOffsets();
        // Keep the native href navigation. Close only after the click finishes.
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          menu.open = false;
          queueUpdate();
        });
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (menu.open && !menu.contains(event.target)) menu.open = false;
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && menu.open) {
        event.preventDefault();
        menu.open = false;
        summary.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('scroll', queueUpdate, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', queueUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('load', queueUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', queueUpdate);

    if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
      const observer = new ResizeObserver(queueUpdate);
      headers.forEach(header => observer.observe(header));
      observer.observe(summary);
    }

    updateOffsets();
    updateCurrentSection();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initPublicationNavigation, { once: true });
  } else {
    initPublicationNavigation();
  }
})();
</script>
```
